Add the angle columns a track layer needs

Source: R/geom-track.R
track_angles.Rd

Translates the node id column into y (the node's angle) and ymin/ymax (its arc, shrunk by width; for "tile", the arc split into one bin per row of that node). This runs once, when the layer is added, because ggplot2 runs positions after the geom setup: anything a geom lists in required_aes must exist by then. The radial extent of a tile band is the position's job, not this function's.

Usage

track_angles(
  data,
  node,
  layout,
  width = 0.9,
  geom = "col",
  has_value = FALSE,
  ...,
  aggregate = NULL,
  layouts = NULL,
  group = NULL
)

Arguments

data

Layer data.

node

Name of the node id column.

layout

A circos_layout (or its node table).

width

Fraction of the node arc used by the layer.

geom

Track geometry name.

has_value

Whether the caller already supplies the values, either as a data column named x or through a mapping. When TRUE no placeholder column is written, because a column called x would shadow the layer's own mapping and every value would scale to the same radius.

...

Ignored; kept so older calls that passed band_width still work. aggregate sits after ... on purpose, so it can only be given by name: a positional argument there would silently land on it.

aggregate

Whether this geom's stat folds a node's rows into one mark ("boxplot", "violin"). Such a mark keeps the node's whole arc rather than one bin of it. NULL asks track_geom_spec(); pass it explicitly when calling this function with a geometry of your own.

layouts

A circos_layouts list (the by = result) instead of a single layout: every row is then placed by the node table of its own group, so two rings may put the same id at different angles.

group

Name of the column in data that says which group a row belongs to. Required with layouts.

Value

data with the angle columns added.

Examples

lay <- circos_layout(cor(mtcars))
head(track_angles(
    data.frame(id = colnames(mtcars)), "id", lay, 0.9, "col"
))
#>     id x         y .circos_theta .circos_arc       ymin      ymax
#> 1  mpg 0 0.2541834     0.2541834   0.5083668 0.02541834 0.4829485
#> 2  cyl 0 0.8253821     0.8253821   0.5083668 0.59661700 1.0541471
#> 3 disp 0 1.3965807     1.3965807   0.5083668 1.16781567 1.6253458
#> 4   hp 0 1.9677794     1.9677794   0.5083668 1.73901433 2.1965445
#> 5 drat 0 2.5389781     2.5389781   0.5083668 2.31021300 2.7677431
#> 6   wt 0 3.1101767     3.1101767   0.5083668 2.88141166 3.3389418
